executive_summary: MLOps Engineering, Reproduction, and Production Machine Learning Systems are the future of machine learning. Regression testing, fault tolerance, and operational telemetry are covered in this introductory lecture. Furthermore, it focuses on the architecture of feature stores and metadata registries in enterprise machine learning platforms. Finally, the module focuses on modular repository design and automated software testing for machine learning pipelines.
